about.title: About — Eleva.care
about.description: Eleva Care connects women with independent, licensed women's health experts. Meet our mission, our beliefs and the team behind it.
about.heading: Transforming women's health with compassion and
about.intro: We're here to make it easier to find the right help, at the right moment. Eleva Care connects you with licensed care experts through a secure, trusted technology platform.

mission.heading: Care you can trust, at every step
mission.p1: We believe every woman deserves access to knowledgeable, compassionate care. Our platform helps you find independent, licensed experts you can trust, so you feel supported at every step.
mission.p2: We provide the technology that makes care simpler to access. Your chosen expert provides your care. Together, we help you move forward with confidence.

vision.heading: Bridging science and care, so support feels
vision.lead: We bring trusted expertise closer to you, making specialised care easier to access across every life stage.

access.title: Quality care access
access.description: Every woman deserves access to quality care, regardless of location or circumstances.

knowledge.title: Knowledge is power
knowledge.description: Clear, evidence-based information helps you make confident health decisions.

collaborative.title: Collaborative care
collaborative.description: Better outcomes happen when people work together with trusted professionals.

lifelong.title: A lifelong journey
lifelong.description: Women's health is a lifelong journey with changing needs, and we meet you where you are.

team.heading: Led by healthcare innovators and compassionate experts
team.p1: Eleva Care grew from a simple idea: expert care should be easier to reach. Our founders and advisors saw the gaps women face, and built a better way to connect you with trusted professionals.
team.p2: Today, Eleva Care operates a secure digital platform that connects women with independent, licensed care experts. We provide the technology; your chosen expert provides your care.

advisors.heading: Board of advisors
advisors.lead: Our advisory board brings together leaders in women's health, innovation and clinical research.

kariBo.quote: Evidence-based pelvic-floor muscle training not only prevents and treats dysfunction; it empowers women to live confidently and fully at every stage of life.

rubenBarakat.quote: Evidence shows that personalised exercise during pregnancy can transform women's health outcomes.

alexandreDelgado.quote: Evidence-based physical therapy transforms the pregnancy and birth experience, empowering women through every stage.

cristineHomsiJorge.quote: Clinical research and education empower women to make informed decisions about their health.

annelieGutke.quote: Understanding pain mechanisms transforms how we care for women during pregnancy and beyond.

joanaBarros.quote: Seamless, team-based care across every life stage, from adolescence through pregnancy, childbirth and menopause, ensures women receive the personalised support they need to thrive.

patriciaDriusso.quote: Clinical research advances rehabilitation while empowering women through evidence-based education.

jennyBagwell.role: Board advisor, biomechanics and perinatal health
jennyBagwell.quote: Understanding movement patterns during and after pregnancy helps optimise care and improve long-term outcomes for women.

becomeExpert.title: Become an expert — Eleva.care
becomeExpert.description: Join Eleva.care as an independent, licensed professional on a digital health platform.
becomeExpert.heading: Practise on Eleva.care
becomeExpert.body: Eleva.care is a digital health platform for independent, licensed professionals. You keep full clinical autonomy. Eleva runs the scheduling, booking and payment technology, so members can book sessions with you online, by phone or in person.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up and open your expert practice from your account. You start on the standard plan: a 15% fee per booking, nothing else.

steps.title: Set up your practice
steps.body: Add your profile, languages, locations and weekly availability. Connect your calendars so busy times are blocked automatically.

steps.title: Publish your services
steps.body: Offer online, in-person or phone sessions with a price and a Flexible, Moderate or Strict cancellation policy for each service. Verify your identity and connect payouts with Stripe before you publish.

steps.title: Get booked by members
steps.body: Members book and pay online. You and the member receive confirmations and reminders by email.

benefits.title: Full clinical independence
benefits.body: You remain an independent, licensed professional. Eleva provides scheduling, booking and payment technology—you decide how to care for each member.

benefits.title: Your rates and policies
benefits.body: Set your prices and a Flexible, Moderate or Strict cancellation policy for each service. Eleva keeps 15% of each booking, with no other deductions. Your share reaches your Stripe account on the later of 7 days after payment or 24 hours after the session; Stripe then pays it to your bank.

benefits.title: Flexible scheduling
benefits.body: Publish weekly availability, connect external calendars, and offer online, phone or in-person sessions from one practice.

benefits.title: Secure sessions
benefits.body: Video rooms, reminders and join links are built in. Sessions are not recorded.

benefits.title: Members find you
benefits.body: Members find you in the Eleva directory and on your own profile page, in their language.

benefits.title: Your practice in one place
benefits.body: Your booking page, services, cancellation policies, calendar and earnings, all in one place.

requirements.title: Registered health professional
requirements.body: You work in a regulated health profession with active registration in your professional body (in Portugal, your Ordem). We check your registration before your profile goes live.

requirements.title: Honest, evidence-based words
requirements.body: Your profile and services promise no results, quote no unproven figures, and make clear that you, not Eleva, provide the care.

requirements.title: Languages you publish
requirements.body: Write profile and service copy in the languages you actually offer (English, Portuguese or Spanish).

requirements.title: Payouts through Stripe
requirements.body: Stripe checks your identity and bank details before your paid services go live.

becomeExpert.finalBody: Create your account and start on the standard plan. Your terms are the Expert agreement you accept when you register. If we change it, we email you at least 15 days before, and you can leave before the change applies.

history.title: Our story — Eleva.care
history.description: A letter from our founder, Patrícia Mota, about why Eleva Care exists.
history.heading: The story behind
history.lead: How a physiotherapist became a pioneer in evidence-based women's health.
history.author: Patrícia Mota
history.authorRole: Founder, physiotherapist and PhD in biomechanics

sections.title: Hello!
paragraphs: Hi! I'm Patrícia Mota, a physiotherapist, and I'd like to share with you how Eleva Care was born.

Movement has been part of my life since I was a child: first through rhythmic gymnastics, then through synchronised swimming. When I became a physiotherapist, I worked mainly with musculoskeletal and orthopaedic conditions. That's when I faced a challenge: when my patients became pregnant, I didn't feel prepared to answer their questions. I'll admit it bothered me not to have clear answers for people who trusted me.

sections.title: The academic journey
paragraphs: This feeling led me to pursue a PhD in Biomechanics with Professor Kari Bø, studying how abdominal muscles adapt during pregnancy and after childbirth. Meanwhile, I became a mother of three and personally experienced many of the issues I was researching.
I realised something important: although strong scientific evidence exists, there's a huge gap between the knowledge being produced and what actually reaches people.

sections.title: The problem I discovered
paragraphs: On one hand, we already have a lot of evidence about effective strategies for women's health, but this knowledge often remains trapped in scientific articles that are hard to access and understand for those outside the field. It takes time for information to be translated into clinical practice, and even longer to reach the general public.

At the same time, we see countless promises on social media of quick fixes for complex women's health issues, from getting your pre-pregnancy body back in record time to miracle exercises for urinary incontinence. Too often these so-called solutions are clever marketing with no scientific foundation.

What worries me isn't just misinformation itself, but how it can pull women away from approaches that truly work: those based on solid science and clinical experience. Symptoms like incontinence, pelvic pain, sexual dysfunction or musculoskeletal changes have proven solutions that often don't reach the women who need them.

sections.title: The moment of inspiration
paragraphs: While working on a research project in California with Jenny Bagwell, I missed my patients deeply. That distance made me think: why not create a way to deliver high-quality information and specialised care to women everywhere, regardless of where they live?
That's when Rodrigo, my husband, brought all these pieces together and created the Eleva Care platform. Maybe we're reinventing the wheel a little, after all.

sections.title: Our mission
paragraphs: We want to build a bridge between cutting-edge science and the people who need it, in a truly accessible way: world-class women's health care, available whenever and wherever it's needed.
Our vision is simple: a secure digital platform that connects any woman with independent, licensed women's health specialists, adapting to her time and location, not the other way around.

sections.title: The team I'm proud of
paragraphs: When I shared this idea with colleagues I admire, the response was warm and immediate. Today we have a group of advisors who fill me with pride and gratitude. They are extraordinarily experienced professionals, true leaders in their fields.

More than that, they're people I deeply care for, who have already contributed so much to what Eleva Care is today. Their generosity in sharing knowledge, experience and vision has been essential to our growth.
At the same time, we're growing a network of independent professionals I trust completely: people who share the same values and the same passion for evidence-based care.

Eleva Care is taking its first steps. We're learning and growing every day. If you connect with this vision, whether as a professional who wants to collaborate or as someone seeking evidence-based care, our door is open. We want every woman who reaches out to know she'll receive guidance grounded in the best available evidence and in the clinical experience of specialised professionals.
Share this vision with the family and friends who are looking for information on women's health. Help us spread knowledge in a way that is both accessible and high quality.
